description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 3 approaches from the opposite direction of Vehicle 1 and turns left onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 4 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in an adjacent lane; Vehicle 4 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane on the exit road. On the exit road, first a parked vehicle partially blocks the right edge near the merge region. Twenty meters later, a diagonal line of 5 cones partially blocks the lane (starting near the left edge and ending near the center). Farther down, a pedestrian crosses perpendicularly from the right edge to the left edge of the exit road.
